exposure: Pregnant women were divided into subgroups after the OGTT: GDM, normal result and not tested.
GDM risk (high risk vs low risk)
cohort: 5021 non-selected pregnant women receiving antenatal care in Tartu University Hospital, Estonia between 2012-2018
finding: An increasing number of pregnancies presenting GDM risk factors are diagnosed with GDM, and even pregnant women with GDM risk factors but normal OGTT results are at risk of increased weight gain and LGA newborns.
